# Index Template

Instances use `type: index`. Required: purpose, an ordered navigation list/table and reading guidance. Optional: scope boundaries and a short terminology guide. Do not duplicate reference contracts or maintain a second decision catalogue.

## Document skeleton

```markdown
---
type: index
---

# {{Area name}}

{{Purpose and scope}}

## Contents

{{Links to the current documents with a one-sentence responsibility each}}

## Reading guide

{{Recommended entry point and useful relationships}}
```
